# Benchmark results

*Generated by `scripts/make_report.py` from `results/*.json`. Do not edit by hand; re-run the benchmarks and regenerate.*

All figures are **simulated in-process replay on one thread** of synthetic commands (not exchange throughput). Throughput is the median over trials of an untimed pass; latencies come from a separate per-command-timed pass, so they include two clock reads (`clockReadNs` below) and are quantized to the clock tick (about 42 ns on Apple silicon). Heap is live malloc bytes after the run minus before. "consistent" means every strategy produced the identical trade stream (hash) and final active-order count.
